bootstrap.reconnect: Open the paired Daymark workspace and wait for the ready event.

authorization.boundary: The agent operates only inside the already authorized Daymark document.
authorization.workspaceCredential: The private pairing code remains inside browser or Android storage and is never returned by discovery or health endpoints.
authorization.revocation: Remove the authorized browser session or rotate the workspace pairing from Daymark settings.

dataHandling.publicEndpoints: Discovery and health expose no workspace contents.
dataHandling.workspaceReads: Use DaymarkAI.getState from the authorized document.
dataHandling.workspaceMutations: Use documented DaymarkAI operations so local-first validation, sync conflict handling, and tombstones remain in effect.
